description: Create a GPSR company (manufacturer or EU responsible person), or update one when id is given. The email is the key Amazon matches against the record in Seller Central, so it must be exactly that record's email — ask the user, never guess one. Name is unique in the workspace. Then assign it with assign_economic_operators. The result echoes the workspace.

company.description: name, email (required); phone, website, addressLine1, addressLine2, city, postalCode, stateOrProvince, country (two-letter code).

id.description: The company to update; omit to create one.

name: save_economic_operator
title: Save a GPSR company
